subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should these exact upstream action revisions be accepted together for the repository's token-bearing, security-scanning, release-publishing, and Codex-agent workflows?
rationale: Source review found no concrete defect, but the changed actions execute across privileged and scheduled paths that the available PR checks cannot exhaustively validate; repository ownership policy reserves the security workflows for explicit owner review.

options.title: Approve after owner checks
options.body: Have security and automation/release owners verify the exact revisions and complete final-head workflow checks before merging the grouped update.

options.title: Split by risk domain
options.body: Replace this grouped update with separate security, Docker/release, repository-automation, and Codex-action updates for narrower validation and rollback.

recommendation.title: Approve after owner checks
recommendation.body: Have security and automation/release owners verify the exact revisions and complete final-head workflow checks before merging the grouped update.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows the broadest ownership signal across the CI, action-pin, and workflow-modernization surfaces affected here.
